archetype: ARCHETYPE 2: PERFORMANCE PRO & SWISS HIGH-CONTRAST (Encouraging, Non-Judgmental Student Fitness)
emotional_tone: Restrained, encouraging, calm, focused, structured, non-judgmental. High-contrast precision designed for tertiary students balancing academic timetables and realistic physical routines.
theme: Light & Dark Mode Adaptive (Default: Modern Deep Obsidian & Slate background with crisp warm white card surfaces in light mode, high contrast typography, zero clutter)

typography.anti_pattern_rule: NEVER use Inter for main titles or H1/H2 headlines. Use Outfit or Cabinet Grotesk with tracking-tight. Mono font reserved for rest timers, rep counts, timestamp tags, and calendar slot hours.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy.small_label: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

colors.contrast_rules: All text must strictly meet minimum 4.5:1 WCAG AA contrast ratio. Interactive buttons must have a distinct 2px focus ring with 4px offset. Never use color alone to signal status (always pair color with icons and descriptive text, e.g., 'Completed [Checkmark]').

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous spacing philosophy (2-3x default padding). Ample negative space to prevent cognitive overwhelm during busy study weeks.
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: Mode B: High Density & Scanning for Dashboard / Weekly Calendar. Mode A: Tetris style for Onboarding Preview and Feature highlights.
layout_and_spacing.container_padding: Internal padding of p-6 or p-8 inside bordered cards to avoid text collision.
layout_and_spacing.responsive_breakpoints: Mobile-first structure. Single column grid on mobile (grid-cols-1), expand to md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 or 12-column grid for timetable builder.

navigation.type: Top Navbar with sticky crystal glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/85 dark:bg-slate-950/85 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 z-50)
navigation.accessibility: Includes a skip-to-content link ('#main-content') at the top of DOM, visible on focus.

onboarding_wizard.pattern: One question at a time with instant inline validation and step indicators. Right-hand live preview panel showing real-time suggested weekly timetable grid.

weekly_builder.pattern: Interactive drag-and-drop or explicit 'Reschedule' / 'Swap' modal buttons. Includes explicit 'Plan Saved' toast notification and unsaved changes confirmation banner.

dashboard.pattern: Focus on Next Session card with large 'Start Session' action button. Non-judgmental missed session handler offering neutral choices: 'Move this session' or 'Continue with next session' without guilt messages.

workout_player.pattern: Single-exercise step view featuring clear exercise photo, target reps/duration, step-by-step instructions, rest timer with +30s/-10s adjustments, exercise substitution button, and non-intrusive safety note.

peer_accountability.pattern: Opt-in social feed with 'Well done' reactions, friend requests by username, mute/block/report actions. Privacy by default (sharing workouts disabled by default).

challenges.pattern: Small group consistency challenges (max 8 members), cooperative language ('8/8 days completed together'), NO competitive leaderboards or rankings.

accessibility_requirements.keyboard: 100% keyboard operable with visible outline-2 ring-offset-2 focus indicators.
accessibility_requirements.screen_reader: aria-live regions for timer count updates, plan saved alerts, and rest countdowns.
accessibility_requirements.labels: Icons must ALWAYS be paired with visible text labels or clear aria-labels.
accessibility_requirements.data_testid_rule: EVERY button, input, navigation link, workout card, metric item, dropdown, and tab MUST include a descriptive data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='start-workout-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the JSON rules specified above.
Do NOT alter or delete /app/design_guidelines.json once created.
Ensure all components are implemented using React js and Tailwind CSS with shadcn primitives.
All interactive elements must have clear data-testid attributes for automated verification.
Maintain high contrast, generous spacing, visible focus indicators, skip link, and aria-live announcements.
